summary.tldr: Implements Budget 2025 tax, financial, housing, bankruptcy, and labour measures, including new minimum tax, reporting, and registry rules.
what_it_does: Provides temporary immediate expensing for eligible manufacturing or processing buildings, and adds a recapture rule if a building later has more than 10% non-manufacturing use within 10 years.

Expands mining and clean economy tax rules, including environmental studies, community consultations, clean economy expenditures for flow-through mining shares, and new rules for clean technology, clean electricity, and clean hydrogen investment tax credits.

Changes tax rules for employer contributions to group sickness or accident plans, employee expense reimbursements, flipped property trusts, charity reporting and penalties, and adds crypto-asset reporting rules for 2027 and later.

Adds domestic minimum top-up tax rules, a Canadian under-taxed profits rule for multinational groups, new safe harbour rules, and says tax treaties do not stop the Global Minimum Tax Act from applying.

Changes GST/HST, excise, and financial institution rules, and updates qualified and prohibited investments for registered plans, including rules for Lloyd's associations, first home savings accounts, and Canadian Payments Association cheque clearing services.

Changes bank, insurance, housing, bankruptcy, contract, and federal labour rules, including banning some bearer-form conversion documents, raising Tax Court limits, setting housing-related ceilings, and restricting some non-compete clauses for federal employees.
summary.background: This is the second bill to implement certain budget measures tabled in Parliament on November 4, 2025.
